name: Magnifier Image Gallery
description: Vertical stack of captioned image cards where hovering an image shows a circular magnifier lens that follows the cursor and zooms into the photo.
contents: Stack of image cards, each with index label, tag pill, image, title, subtitle and credit link
Circular zoom lens overlay on the hovered image
behavior: Circular lens follows the cursor over the image and shows a magnified view
Lens fades out on mouse leave
Image loses its grayscale and scales slightly on card hover
editableByProps: Images, titles, tags, credits and links
Zoom level, lens size and card width
Labels, background, text and accent colors
fixed: Lens is mouse hover only; images remain visible on touch devices
Cards stack vertically with fixed spacing (space-y-32)
